title: Wire acp_mcp_bridge child source via include_str for orphan_sources
goal: Embed tests/acp_mcp_bridge/mcp_child.rs via include_str! in tests/acp_mcp_bridge.rs and write it to fx.root.join("mcp_child.rs") before invoking rustc so tests/orphan_sources recognizes the fixture as statically reached without changing compiled behavior.

reuse.searched: Checked tests/orphan_sources.rs (lines 273-291 and 369-371) which already resolves include_str!(...) paths relative to the declaring test file; using include_str!("acp_mcp_bridge/mcp_child.rs") reuses that mechanism cleanly.
